sentences.en: Your income is about twice as large as mine is.
sentences.zh: 你的收入大约是我的两倍。

sentences.en: Your watch is similar to mine in shape and color.
sentences.zh: 你的手表在形状和颜色上与我的相似。

sentences.en: There is a fundamental difference between your opinion and mine.
sentences.zh: 你意见的根本不同在于我。
